This activity is then participated by Cyp2c8, indicating a potential functional link between Cyp2c9 and Cyp2c8. The integration of these pathways implies that Mefenamic Acid may influence Cyp2c8 through a mechanism involving Cyp2c9, possibly by modulating its enzymatic activity. The observed scores suggest a strong, reliable interaction, though the exact mechanism of how Mefenamic Acid affects Cyp2c8 remains to be fully elucidated.
